<function name="SprayDecal" parent="Player" type="classfunc">
	<description>Makes a player spray their decal.</description>
	<realm>Server</realm>
	<args>
		<arg name="sprayOrigin" type="Vector">The location to spray from</arg>
		<arg name="sprayEndPos" type="Vector">The location to spray to</arg>
	</args>
</function>

<example>
	<description>Makes the player spray their decal 5000 units away.</description>
<code>
local ply = Entity( 1 )
local eyepos = ply:EyePos()
ply:SprayDecal( eyepos, eyepos + ply:GetAimVector() * 5000 )
</code>

</example>
